query: Add this to /resources/toolkit — I dropped hvac-checklist.md and img.png in the repo root. It's an HVAC Preventive Maintenance Checklist for School Facilities, make it a downloadable toolkit item.
expected_behavior: Runs the marketing-pages preflight guard (content.sh check-repo) and refuses to write if the checkout is not marketing-pages

Resolves the destination and the front-matter schema from the repo's content profile (content.sh pipeline/collection toolkit) rather than hardcoded paths, and stops with a message naming what it needed if the repo declares none
Reformats the source into that declared schema, setting category to one of the profile's declared enum values, derives + confirms the slug, and writes the item at the resolved destination
Verifies every internal link resolves (lychee plus content.sh check-link) and converts facilitron.com URLs to relative paths before building the PDF

Builds a trimmed branded PDF via tron:md-to-pdf (LaTeX path) containing only the actionable checklist body, gets user sign-off, then uploads it with --name to the folder the profile declares for the pdf role

Converts the card image to .webp and uploads it with --name to the folder the profile declares for the card role, then writes each asset's `reference` value verbatim into front matter so image:/download: match the uploaded assets exactly

Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice), uses plain bullets inside ::checklist-group (no double-box - [ ]), cleans up the dropped-in source markdown and image, and runs the verification loop before reporting paths and URLs
